supersedes_utility_layers: phase_c_v2 (six metrics on the v1 union basis)
determined_by: a structural isolation invariant, not metric performance. The audit compared candidate bases and found the original frame removed valid clustering partitions from every metric's comparison universe; no utility magnitude or ranking was used to reach that conclusion.

defect.detail: Phase C created a candidate row only when at least one metric produced a valid value, so the utility universe was the union over metrics of their valid candidates. 392 valid fixed32 clustering partitions -- including K=1 partitions on which every one of the 61 CVIs is undefined -- were therefore absent from every metric's comparison universe.
defect.why_it_matters: the frozen Stage-3B utility is frame-relative by design: k_top and k_bottom are 10 percent of len(frame), the eligibility guard is 20 percent of len(frame), and a metric's invalid candidates are ranked worst rather than dropped. The candidate basis is part of the measurement.

canonical_basis.definition: every candidate in the frozen Fixed32CandidateBank with a valid clustering partition and an available candidate ARI
canonical_basis.excluded: only slots whose clustering itself failed
canonical_basis.per_metric_rule: left-join each metric's evaluation onto the canonical candidate ids; a metric being invalid or non-finite on a candidate affects only that metric's value and status, and never deletes the candidate row

utility_definition_statement: The mathematical utility definition is UNCHANGED. Formula, component weights, Spearman and Kendall handling, pairwise accuracy, NDCG, top-k and bottom-k, invalid-value treatment, orientation and minimum-valid semantics are all exactly as frozen. Only the candidate-frame assembly that feeds the function is corrected. This is not a post-hoc redesign of the utility function.
unchanged_scientific_objects: fixed32 candidate partitions and labels (4800 slots, 4776 valid)
the utility formula and its weights
the corpus and its frozen representation checksums
changed_layer: candidate-frame assembly for metric utility only

metric_value_sources.resolution_rule: exactly one authoritative status/value per logical candidate x metric combination; the superseded v1 rows for the repaired six are ignored, never merged
